Pan Atlantic University PAU Mastercard Scholarship Details

The Pan Atlantic University PAU Mastercard Scholarship is a fully funded opportunity for aspiring undergraduates to fulfil their dreams and unlock their potential.

As the first Nigerian university to partner with the Mastercard Foundation on this transformative initiative, Pan Atlantic University is committed to empowering and educating 650 Mastercard Foundation Scholars over the next ten years.

The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Pan-Atlantic University (PAU) is dedicated to:

  • Providing access to high-quality education: Ensuring that talented individuals have the opportunity to pursue their academic goals.

  • Developing future leaders: Cultivating entrepreneurial spirit, strong leadership skills, and a commitment to social responsibility within Scholars.

  • Fostering career success: Equipping Scholars with the necessary skills, connections, and experiences to thrive in the professional world through internships, mentorship, and career guidance.

  • Driving positive social change: Empowering Scholars to contribute to their communities through impactful service projects.

Pan Atlantic University Mastercard Foundation Scholarship Benefits

The Pan Atlantic University Mastercard Foundation Scholarship offers;

  • Full tuition coverage

  • Accommodation and living expenses

  • Mentorship and leadership development

  • Internship and career support

  • Networking opportunities

Pan Atlantic University Mastercard Scholarship 2026 Requirements

To be eligible for the undergraduate Pan Atlantic University Mastercard Scholarship 2025, applicants must satisfy the following conditions:

  • Demonstrate academic excellence

  • Demonstrate leadership potential

  • Demonstrate financial need

  • Are young women interested in STEM programmes

  • Are internally displaced young people

  • Are young people with disabilities

  • Demonstrate commitment to giving back to their community.

  • Must have passed WAEC/ NECO/ GCE/ NABTEB with 5 credits including English and Mathematics and three other subjects in Arts, Sciences and Social Science in not more than two sittings.

  • UTME Minimum Score of 220 (The required UTME subjects are English Language and any three of Social Science, Arts or Science subjects)

Required Documents for Pan Atlantic University PAU Mastercard Scholarship 2026

While applying for the PAU Mastercard Scholarship 2025, you will be required to submit the following documents;

  • Complete Application Form

  • O’Level Result

  • UTME Result

  • Letter of Application

  • Essays and Personal Statement

  • Passport Photograph

How To Apply for Pan Atlantic University PAU Mastercard Scholarship 2026

To apply for the Pan Atlantic University PAU Mastercard Scholarship 2026, follow the instructions we have outlined below; 

  • Read the information we have provided on this webpage and ensure your eligibility

  • Click the green button below to proceed to the PAU/Mastercard webpage.

Step 2: Fill Out the Application Interest Form

  • Interested candidates who DO NOT have their UTME result should complete the Interest Form to indicate their desire to apply and begin the screening process.

Step 3: Write the JAMB UTME

  • Applicants must sit for the Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board – Unified Tertiary Matriculation Examination (JAMB UTME).

  • A minimum score of 220 is required to proceed to the next stage.

Step 4: Complete the Online Application Form

  • Eligible candidates who have the CURRENT year UTME results should complete the application form, providing personal, academic, and background information, including documentation.

  • Educational Resources

Step 5: Screening and Shortlisting for Interviews

  • Applications are reviewed for alignment with eligibility and Scholars Program goals.

  • Shortlisted candidates are invited for an interview, which may be held in-person or virtually, depending on location and circumstance.

Step 6: Admission and Scholarship Award

  • Successful candidates will be notified of admission into Pan-Atlantic University and a formal scholarship award offer under the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program.
